BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Why is prevalence of AIDS in Africa so high? ASSISTANT:

The prevalence of AIDS in Africa is so high due to several factors, including poverty, lack of education, unequal gender dynamics, and weak health systems. Additionally, cultural practices such as early marriage and lack of access to contraception further contribute to the spread of the virus.
